s: (１)Why does the writer say,“Every day from day to night / I saw her in the dress so bright”?
p:
Yellow Dress
by Janet Lee
Mary had a yellow dress
Bought from the department store.
It looked as beautiful as the moon,
And as bright as the sun.
Mary wore all the time
The yellow dress I felt so right.
Every day from day to night
I saw her in the dress so bright.
“Buy me a yellow dress,”
I cried to Mom and Dad,
“As beautiful and bright
As the dress the girl living near has!”
I cried and cried and cried,
Until they said with sad eyes,
“We need food for your baby sister,
And clothes for your coming brother.”
Since then I've learned
Mary's yellow dress
Is better to dream of
Than to ask for.
【99　年第　2　次基測】
o: The dress had sun shapes on it.
The writer liked the dress very much.
The dress was Mary's school uniform.

s: (２)What is Jude doing in Bluelake?
p: 【99　年第　2　次基測】

s: (３)Which picture best shows what Jude sees out of his bedroom window?
p: 【99　年第　2　次基測】
e: 在文章裡提及：我可以看到一個有花和樹的漂亮綠色小山坡。很多人會在那裡野餐或放風箏。故答案選(Ｄ)。

s: (１)What does four seasons mean in the reading?
p: 【99　年第　2　次基測】
e: 在文章裡提及：When I was a child（當我還是小孩）；When I was a teenager（當我在青少年期）；But then...（而後）…；Now I am old（現在我老了）。因此表示作者人生的四個階段。故答案選(Ａ)。

s: (２)Which is most likely true about the writer?
p: 【99　年第　2　次基測】
o: She has a strong and healthy body.
She enjoys growing flowers in her garden.
She tries hard to forget what happened in the past.
e: 文章裡提及：現在我老了，我的身體很虛弱，但是我的心智變得堅強和清晰，那是因為在我年輕時代的那些經驗。故答案選(Ａ)。

s: (１)What can we learn about Eric in the reading?
p:
I had a dream ─ a strange dream that has helped me to understand Eric much better.
　　In the dream, Eric looked angry and said, “Melissa, I have something to tell you.”
　　I've lived with Eric for more than five years. He is the cutest thing I've ever seen. I buy him fish and milk and lots of toy mice once a week. I even bought a small house for him, because he sometimes likes to be left only by himself. I love him with all my heart, and give him all I love.
　　But what has gone wrong? In the dream Eric said angrily, “I don't like fish. I don't like milk. And toy mice? Are you crazy? I'm not a cat. And I don't want to be a cat, either!” Then he ran back to his small house.
　　After the dream, I know better: dogs don't like fish or milk. And surely they do not like toy mice. Most important of all, they will let you know when they are really angry!
【99　年第　2　次基測】
e: 在文章提及：在這夢過後，我更清楚知道：狗狗們不喜歡魚或牛奶。由此可知　Eric　是隻寵物狗。故答案選(Ｂ)。
